text:
Miguel: Quick handoff — EU model-pool had OOM restart cycle overnight, brief customer impact.
Aisha: TL;DR? How bad was the impact?
Miguel: Between 01:42–02:00 UTC we saw ~12k requests fail with 502/503s originating from eu-model-pool nodes (about 4% of EU traffic). Two pages: 01:44 and 01:51. We triggered capacity fallback to cpu-encoders which reduced throughput but kept errors limited.
Priya: Primary for next 8h: I'm on primary, Aisha will be secondary until 11:30 UTC. Coverage note: APAC coverage still thin between 21:00–02:00 PT.
Ravi: Acknowledged, I'll pick up APAC escalations if they come in.
Miguel: Root cause: a memory leak in model-runtime v2.7.1 in the attention cache flush path — caused gradual memory growth leading to OOMKills on warm nodes. Reproduced in staging with stress tester.
Aisha: Mitigations we ran:
```
# cordon bad nodes
kubectl -n inference cordon eu-node-17 eu-node-18
# scale up ephemeral pool
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-pool-eu --replicas=40
# rollback to stable model runtime
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/model-pool-eu model-runtime=redwood/model-runtime:2.7.0-stable
``` 
Miguel: Also toggled per-pod max_batch_tokens=800 for 20m to reduce mem pressure and enabled instant fallback to smaller model variant (gpt-small-compat) for new sessions.
Oncall-Runbook-Bot: Runbook link verified (model-pool-oom) — last updated 2026-01-27 by @Devex.
Priya: Current status: no active pager. Error rate dropped to baseline by 02:20 UTC. We have a rolling restart ongoing to ensure no residual pods on v2.7.1.
Support-Bot: Support ticket #INC-3573 created for BrightLeaf (customer observed 502s), assigned to @Sam-Support.
Sam-Support: I'll send timeline and offer one day of service credit. Will attach logs from s3://redwood-ops/incident-3573/
Ravi: Observability actions: added an alert "model_runtime_mem_growth_eu" (threshold: pod mem > 85% for 5m). Also added Grafana panel for per-replica RSS and batch token size.
Oncall-Alert-Bot: Alert rule created: model_runtime_mem_growth_eu threshold 85% for 5m.
Miguel: Short-term action items:
- Blocklist v2.7.1 from auto-deploys (Miguel)
- Add restart-on-oom policy and memory request bump for model-pool (Eng-Platform)
- Postmortem owner: Priya (draft due EOD tomorrow)
Aisha: Medium-term:
- Add continuous mem-leak fuzzer to preprod (Eng-ML)
- Add heap/alloc tracing in runtime (Research)
- Consider circuit to gracefully shed requests instead of hard OOM
Priya: Handoff checklist: primary owns pages & postmortem, secondary assists & handles support comms, oncall-manager escalate if coverage gaps. Postmortem: Priya owner, Miguel implementers, Aisha to coordinate support comms.
Miguel: I'll raise a PR to pin runtime to 2.7.0 in kustomize and add canary test for mem regression.
Aisha: Logs and traces archived: s3://redwood-ops/incident-3659991234/trace-id: trace-c1d2e3f. If anyone needs deeper traces ask me and I'll paste link.
Priya: I'm good to take this forward. Handing over now. :rocket:
Miguel: Leaving note in pager and will follow PR. :thumbsup:
